cases.question: What is the measured imported energy in kWh for the sample?

  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN meter_readings.quality_status = 'VALID' AND meter_readings.is_estimated = 'false'
      THEN meter_readings.import_kwh

cases.question: Show measured imported energy in kWh by customer class.
cases.message: AI will query the published metric for: Show measured imported energy in kWh by customer class.
cases.sql:
SELECT
  meters.customer_class AS customer_class,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN meter_readings.quality_status = 'VALID' AND meter_readings.is_estimated = 'false'
      THEN meter_readings.import_kwh
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS measured_import_kwh
FROM meter_readings AS meter_readings
INNER JOIN meters AS meters
  ON meter_readings.meter_id = meters.meter_id
GROUP BY
  meters.customer_class
LIMIT 100
